name: neals_funnel_centered
title: Neal's Funnel (Centered Parameterization)
description: Neal's Funnel is a classic synthetic distribution with a challenging geometry for MCMC algorithms. In this centered parameterization, the lower-level variables are sampled directly from a normal distribution whose variance is determined by the upper-level variable. This direct dependency creates the steep 'funnel' shape with varying curvature that often traps standard samplers.
